evidence.claim: A stratum at threshold minus epsilon does not expand; the same stratum at threshold plus epsilon fires and re-queues the whole class.
Expansion is one-shot and intra-class: a second evaluate on an already-expanded class enqueues nothing, and firing class A never enqueues class B.

tests.name: stratum at threshold minus epsilon is silent
stratum at threshold plus epsilon fires census requeue
minus and plus epsilon decisions are not identical
rate equal to threshold does not fire
excluding BLOCKED members flips the fire/silent decision
one-shot intra-class expansion; no cross-class enqueue
committed threshold timestamp predates every confirmation receipt

negative_controls.description: Injected rate threshold-epsilon is silent; threshold+epsilon fires. Identical outputs would mean the comparison is inert.
Class A above threshold fires; class B at zero discrepancies stays silent and is not enqueued by A's expansion.

reviewer.notes: Named probe1 re-runs minus/plus epsilon against escalate.py. Named probe2 independently re-runs the bound and timestamp proofs. Catalog scoring by a second human policy engineer is independent of G-1 probe-green.

probe.raw_output: in-memory confirmation-policy receipt validates; garbage rejected

retry.policy: zero retries. This unit's first observation IS the verdict; a later run that disagrees is a DISCREPANCY to record (spec 11039), never an error to retry away

report.title: Error-rate threshold fixed in advance plus the executable whole-class escalation
report.question: Implementation target: turn spec line 11041 into code. Fix the discrepancy-rate threshold BEFORE any confirmation runs, because a threshold chosen after seeing results is not a threshold, then implement the trigger that re-queues an entire affected class for census confirmation when a stratum exceeds it. Question: how many additional units does one failing stratum add, and is that expansion bounded or can it cascade without limit?

answer.formula: additional_units(class) = |population(class)| - |sample(class)| when that class's eligible discrepancy rate strictly exceeds the pre-fixed threshold; else 0
bound_rules: strictly greater-than the pre-fixed threshold (exactly-at is silent)
BLOCKED sample members excluded from numerator and denominator
fire re-queues the entire class (census), not a second sample
a class already expanded is not re-enqueued
firing class A never enqueues class B (no dependency cascade)

threshold.source: Pre-registered 10% class-error rate matching CNF-0003's design p and spec :11041 'predefined threshold'. Value is a module constant at command-center/p2-wave/probes/CNF-0004/escalate.py:19, not fitted to a confirmation corpus (this worktree has no confirmation-receipt corpus).

trigger.action: re-queue every id in the affected class for census confirmation; additional units are those not already in the stratum sample
